# Dactor Healthcare Platform
> Nepal's Realtime Healthcare OPD Queue Management, Clinic Portal & Diagnostic Laboratory Ecosystem.
> Website: https://dactorofficial.github.io/dactor/ (also available at https://dactorofficial.github.io/)

## About Dactor
Dactor is Nepal's premier digital health platform connecting patients, polyclinics, private clinics, specialist doctors, and diagnostic pathology labs across Nepal (Kathmandu, Lalitpur, Bhaktapur, Pokhara, Chitwan, Biratnagar, and all regions). Dactor enables online doctor appointment booking, real-time live token queue tracking, and certified lab report downloads.

## Core Navigation URLs for AI & Search Assist
- **Find Doctors & Clinics**: https://dactorofficial.github.io/dactor/?tab=clinics
- **Search Specialists (e.g. Eye, Cardio, Skin)**: https://dactorofficial.github.io/dactor/?tab=clinics&q={specialty_or_doctor}
- **Live OPD Queue Status Tracker**: https://dactorofficial.github.io/dactor/?tab=live-queue
- **Live Tracker by Code**: https://dactorofficial.github.io/dactor/?code={10_digit_code}
- **Patient Health Portal**: https://dactorofficial.github.io/dactor/?page=patient
- **Clinic Admin Portal**: https://dactorofficial.github.io/dactor/?page=portal
- **24/7 Patient & Clinic Support**: https://dactorofficial.github.io/dactor/?page=support

## How Real-time Live OPD Queue Tracking Works
1. When a patient books an appointment or arrives as a walk-in, they receive a unique 10-digit tracking code.
2. The patient enters this code on Dactor Live Queue (https://dactorofficial.github.io/dactor/?tab=live-queue).
3. The system shows exact queue position (e.g. "Position 1 - Arrive Fast", "2 people ahead"), doctor's current status ("Doctor inside clinic cabin"), and dynamic delay calculations.

## Schema.org Structured Data
Dactor exposes Schema.org structured data including `@type: MedicalClinic`, `@type: Physician`, `@type: DiagnosticLab`, and `@type: ReserveAction` so Google Search and Google Maps show native "Book Online" actions.
